text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear pro position in opening and closing","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its stance directly and keeps that position consistent from start to finish."},{"evidence":"three body paragraphs on fuel, safety, and convenience","quality":"organizational control","description":"The essay is arranged into distinct sections that each develop a separate supporting point."},{"evidence":"“more energy efficient, more safe, and more convenient”","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay supports its claim with multiple reasons rather than repeating a single idea."},{"evidence":"mentions half the fuel, sensors, braking control, and taxi system","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay uses several specific details from the article to back up its claims."},{"evidence":"connects lower fuel use to CO2 and pollution","quality":"elaboration","description":"The essay goes beyond quoting the article by explaining why the evidence matters."},{"evidence":"“It is time to advance in the ages…”","quality":"concluding force","description":"The essay ends with a more decisive and persuasive conclusion that reinforces its main argument."}]}
